# Chatty by PersonaliAI

> Open-source AI customer support engine trained on your store and content.
> Answers customer questions, captures leads, and books meetings on website, WhatsApp & Slack.

## Core Architecture
- **Backend**: Python 3.11, FastAPI, Supabase / PostgreSQL with `pgvector` extension for semantic search and RAG retrieval.
- **Frontend**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS v4, Lucide icons.
- **Voice Platform**: Real-time WebRTC audio voice calling powered by LiveKit.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Official 81-tool FastMCP server implementing RFC 7591/8414 dynamic OAuth 2.0 PKCE.
- **Omnichannel Support**: Web chat widget, WhatsApp Business API (with audio voice note transcription), and Slack escalation.
- **E-Commerce Integration**: Native WooCommerce catalog synchronization for automated product search and order status tracking.
- **License**: MIT Open Source License.

## Pricing & Deployment Models
- **Self-Hosted Open Source**: Free ($0 forever under MIT license). Users supply their own hosting (Docker) and LLM API keys.
- **Chatty Cloud Hobby**: $19/month (1,000 AI credits, ~800 conversations, 10M characters, 500 MB storage).
- **Chatty Cloud Standard**: $99/month (10,000 AI credits, ~8,000 conversations, 20M characters, 2 GB storage, white-label).
- **Chatty Cloud Business**: $399/month (40,000 AI credits, ~35,000 conversations, 50M characters, BYOK, Admin Management API).
- **Free Trial**: 14-day fully-featured trial on all cloud plans with zero credit card required.

## Key Features & Differentiators
1. **Zero AI Model Training**: Customer and conversation data is strictly isolated; no proprietary data is used to train foundation models.
2. **Human Agent Takeover**: Seamless live agent escalation directly from the conversation inbox with internal notes.
3. **In-Chat Calendar Booking**: Direct integration with Google Meet and Microsoft Outlook calendar slots inside chat.
4. **Visual Flow Architect**: Multi-branch conversational flow builder for custom lead capture and deflection funnels.
5. **FastMCP Server**: 81 tools enabling external coding agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Grok) to inspect, configure, and monitor customer support bots via standard JSON-RPC.
